responsibility: Contains the reader-side runtime for reconstructing streamed GIMPLE and related metadata from LTO bytecode. It provides low-level tag checking and block reads, builds data_in objects with string tables and tree caches, initializes and frees shared reader state, and handles important deserialization support tasks such as file-name and path canonicalization for locations and reconstruction of the target machine-mode table used by offload/LTO compatibility checks. This is the input companion to the main LTO streamer, focused on decoding infrastructure rather than section fetching or option replay.
